quest.title: Search Chronicle: For Childhood Dreams!
quest.description: Despite two failures, Ranjit has no intention of backing down. Will he turn things around in Sumeru?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x15, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Head for the Jadeplume Terrorshroom's Lair

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Haha, and isn't today another day filled with new hope! Ready to head out, friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: New hope, eh... We can take that to mean your Primo Geovishap communications broke down, then?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Come now, how could you call it a failure? Mortal combat is also communication of a kind.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: From that perspective, you could even say that we had an honest, profound exchange, and gained much knowledge about our respective stances in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: What do they say again? "No friends without a fight?"

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Well, you can't know unless you try!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Well, I'll be honest with you — it's always been my dream to ride a Jadeplume Terrorshroom all through Sumeru...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But the adults would all tell me to not be silly. When I'd ask the Forest Watchers, they'd make troubled faces, tell me not to snoop in risky places.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: So I gave up on those unrealistic dreams and grew up normal like the other kids. My only adventures were with my choices for ingredients when cooking...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But I'd get to thinking sometimes, and then I'd remember that I did once have such distant, strange dreams, just like the Aranara of legend.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But they truly exist, and I once saw them. When did I stop being able to do so? When did I start forgetting them?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: I heard this tale about an unlucky fellow named Kuntur while in Natlan. He became the target of the sun's hatred due to a mistake his father made.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: "Kuntur, Unloved of the Sun" was also ostracized in his tribe, and of course, no Saurian would buddy up with him.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But he didn't give up, nor did he blame his father, or fate! Instead, he proved that he was the equal of any valiant warrior in the tribe through hard work and grit!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: In the end, he accomplished something great, not only earning the recognition of an Iktomisaurus comrade, but also becoming a hero to his tribe.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: When I heard that tale, I, too, gained the courage to pick my childhood dream off the ground where I'd left it.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: So yes, please do help me with the upcoming Jadeplume Terrorshroom "negotiations"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And there you go, dumping it all on us again!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: I mean, I'm no match for it as I am now... but I will help support you, so call me whenever you need me!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No need for too much talk. Shall we?

choices.text: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No worries. I'll wait for you here.

choices.text: Well, I was doing the actual fighting...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: And what fighting it was! Even I could tell that you're an experienced adventurer even amongst adventurers!
